title: How you get paid
intro: Here's how money gets from your customers to you.

steps.caption: See your money
steps.vo: Open Payments and payouts to see all the money that came in, and what's still waiting.

steps.caption: Your payout bank
steps.vo: Card payments go straight to your payout bank. Tap Change bank to use another account.

steps.caption: Coming to your bank
steps.vo: In Money, see what's coming to your bank, and when. Shopinbos never holds your money.

steps.caption: Every paid order
steps.vo: Payouts shows every paid order, and where the money for each one went.

outro: Customers pay by card or bank transfer through Paystack, straight to your bank.
